prompt: Research-style answer needed: how should an agent loop be designed for coding agents? Compare Codex-style, Gemini Flash-style, and generic CLI agent loops. Give convergent rules and differences.
Audit a multi-repo AI video project. Identify modules that exist but are not connected to the real render/watchability path, then propose integration PRs in priority order.
Given a multi-model orchestration that costs 8-10 calls, design an experiment to decide whether it beats one strong model or best-of-3 from that model. Include a kill rule.

A 2019 Tesla Model 3 shows an intermittent driver-seat movement error only on bumps and when the seat moves. Build a safe diagnostic plan focused on wiring/connectors without inventing unsupported service facts.
Draft a concise reply to architects: user is available any day/time, asks them to propose slots, and wants to know what the 12.5 meters in the municipal note means.
A roadmap has many bureaucratic gates but little effect on output quality. Decide what to cut, what to keep, and what to implement next to improve effectiveness, depth, applicability, and creativity.
Design a visual prompt layer between a script generator and image/video generators. It must preserve character consistency, first/second-frame descriptions, and support social videos.
Several PRs are open and some are superseded by a merged PR. Explain which to close, which to keep, and what decision log to write.
Explain the Tiny Experiments method with examples. Focus on what can be controlled besides time, and distinguish book-sourced examples from assumptions.
A benchmark uses keyword must_include checks and drives adaptive routing. Explain why this can be misleading and propose a better measurement setup.
A synthesis step merges panel answers but does not know which source answer was strongest. Explain the failure mode and design a keep-best fix.
A system uses Claude as both judge and drafter. Analyze same-provider bias risk and propose a cross-vendor judge-panel design with aggregation.
Design an outcome ledger for AI answers: record whether an answer affected action, whether it was later corrected, and how it should feed the golden set.
Compare a review round where top answers revise after judge notes vs a debate round where models attack/defend each other's claims. Pick when each should run.
Should multilingual prompting be used as a default diversity strategy for Chinese models in a multi-model panel? Give a test-first rollout plan.
